name: Dual Contouring Octree Data Structures
definition: The Dual Contouring implementation uses an octree with three node types to represent the implicit surface: InternalNode (empty space or non-leaf structure), LeafNode (voxel containing surface intersections with a QEF), and PseudoLeafNode (merged children that form a surface patch but are not at max depth).
summary: Dual Contouring Octree Data Structures use three node types to represent implicit surfaces, differing from uniform grids by handling varying geometric detail levels.
